<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 38:6">Targ. Job XXXVIII, 6</cite>; a. fr.

<cite ref="Kiddushin 44a:15">Kidd. 44ᵃ</cite> <he>אבין בר ס׳ הוא</he> can Abin be relied upon?; <cite ref="Yevamot 64b:17">Yeb. 64ᵇ</cite> <he>אבין דס׳ וכ׳</he> (corr. acc.) A. is a trustworthy authority, Isaac … is not.—Pl. <he>בְּנֵי סַמְכֵי</he>.
<cite ref="Kiddushin 31b:2">Kidd. 31ᵇ</cite> <he>חמשה ב׳ ס׳ וכ׳</he> Abimi had five sons who were authorities in traditional law during the life-time of his own father.
